title: Hodge atoms as occurrence-indexed marker ledgers
description: This note identifies the standard Hodge-atom construction with an occurrence-indexed marker ledger. Degrees of connected components of the reduced unramified Euler spectral cover are expanded into labelled occurrences; the elementary disjoint-union, blowup, and projective-bundle correspondences generate a thin groupoid; and the free commutative monoid on its connected components recovers the Hodge-atom chemical formula. Deleting atom classes carried in dimension at most d - 2 gives an effective quotient that is birationally invariant by weak factorization. As a strictly one-step consequence, a top-height atom on a smooth n-fold obstructs rationality of every rank-two projective bundle carrying it. The note also separates abstract Hodge atoms from geometric atomic F-bundle classes and from the sibling direct quantum-D-module marker specialization.
